opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st day of October (bi-monthly deadlines: 1st February, April, June, August, October, December)

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored up to £750); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society junior scientist members: Scheme A for undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; Schemes B & C for PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva (not undergraduate/Master's). Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on genetics research. Scheme A supports attendance at Genetics Society/SIG meetings; Scheme B supports attendance at non-Genetics Society meetings; Scheme C supports registration for virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant

deadlines.raw: 15th November (quarterly deadlines: 15th February, May, August, November)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or where the course is held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year. Supervisors must be members.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques. Covers travel, accommodation, subsistence and registration/tuition fees.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st November (quarterly deadlines: 1st February, May, August, November)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year. Supervisors must be members.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with field-based genetic research projects, where results would typically be suitable for publication in the Society's journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any Genetics Society member, regardless of age of the person they care for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Award to support attendance at Society meetings for members with caring responsibilities, used as the recipient thinks will best support their attendance. Competitive, must be applied for prior to the meeting/event.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting

amount.raw: Various sponsorship levels; a specific lecture for a few hundred pounds, a session up to about £1,000, major sponsorship of an entire meeting potentially several thousand pounds (recent major sponsorship £1,000-£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards the organisation of a meeting (not attendance). Applications may be made at any time of year.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement

deadlines.raw: 1st October (twice yearly deadlines: 1st March and 1st October)

opportunities.summary: Grants to support public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually. Funding may cover eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings. Applications to become a new Special Interest Group should be submitted at least three months before the first meeting.
